slots.title: Ledger says unauthorized implant found in at least one device sold by CryptoBilis
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in a device linked to crypto losses at CryptoBilis, a Southeast Asian reseller. The company says confirmed cases are limited and its internal systems remain unaffected.

slots.title: Bitcoin shrugs off ETF outflows to trade above $84,000 as oil falls
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin is holding on to its weekend gains as oil trades lower. ETFs lost over $600 million in outflows last week.

slots.title: Why a bug that could have threatened XRP's 100 billion supply cap stayed hidden for years
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The XRP Ledger Foundation said normal parameters never triggered the bug that could have broken XRP's supply cap, which is why it was undetected for years.
